name: LubricationPhys
description: IPhys class for Lubrication w/o FlowEngine. Used by Law2_ScGeom_ImplicitLubricationPhys.

attributes.name: Fn
attributes.description: Linear-elastic part of the normal force of the contact

attributes.name: Fv
attributes.description: Viscous part of the normal force of the contact

attributes.name: delta
attributes.description: $\log(u)$ - used for scheme with $\delta=\log(u)$ variable change

attributes.name: eps
attributes.description: Roughness: fraction of radius used as roughness [-]

attributes.name: frictDissip
attributes.description: frictional energy dissipation in the contact (this value is updated by contact laws applicable to FrictPhys - currently only

attributes.name: keps
attributes.description: stiffness coefficient of the asperities [N/m]. Only used with resolution method=0, with resolution>0 it is always equal to kn.

attributes.name: mRtype
attributes.description: Rolling resistance type, see [Zhou1999536]_. mRtype=1 - equation (3) in [Zhou1999536]_; mRtype=2 - equation (4) in [Zhou1999536]_

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: normalPotentialForce
attributes.description: Normal force from potential other than contact [N]

attributes.name: prevDotU
attributes.description: du/dt from previous integration - used for trapezoidal scheme (see

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).
